बॉलीवुड में स्टार्स की सेफ्टी पर उठा बड़ा सवाल, अब अनन्या पांडे का भी आ गया बड़ा बयान! 😱

Hindustan Times Leadership Summit 2026 के 24वें एडिशन में अनन्या पांडे ने टाइगर श्रॉफ पर हुए हमले पर बात की।

अनन्या ने इस घटना को बेहद डरावना और दुर्भाग्यपूर्ण बताया। उन्होंने कहा कि सुरक्षा की वजह से एक्टर्स और जनता के बीच का कनेक्शन नहीं टूटना चाहिए, लेकिन सबकी सेफ्टी सबसे ज्यादा जरूरी है।

आपको बता दें कि 18 अक्टूबर को शाम 7 बजे मुंबई में एक फुटबॉल क्लब के बाहर टाइगर श्रॉफ की कार पर फायरिंग हुई थी। इस हमले में टाइगर सुरक्षित रहे, लेकिन रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक उनके ड्राइवर और एक राहगीर घायल हो गए थे। 🚨

मामले में MCOCA कोर्ट ने आरोपी फूल सिंह और 4 अन्य आरोपियों की कस्टडी 16 नवंबर तक बढ़ा दी है।

वहीं दूसरी तरफ टाइगर की टीम ने फेक न्यूज और AI कंटेंट फैलाने वालों को चेतावनी दी है कि गलत खबर देने वालों पर लीगल एक्शन लिया जाएगा। ⚖️

क्या आपको भी लगता है कि पब्लिक इवेंट्स पर स्टार्स और फैंस की सुरक्षा के कड़े इंतजाम होने चाहिए? कमेंट्स में अपनी राय दीजिए! 👇

ctx.title: Hindustan Times Leadership Summit 2026: Ananya Panday reacts to Tiger Shroff attack, calls safety concerns on Bollywood actors scary
ctx.summary: Three men attacked Tiger Shroff's car on October 18 in Mumbai, as the Bollywood actor was leaving a football club.
ctx.text:
Actor Ananya Panday was one of the speakers on the 24th edition of the Hindustan Times Leadership Summit 2026, where she spoke about her career, Bollywood today and more. During her conversation with Sonal Kalra, Chief Managing Editor, Entertainment and Lifestyle, Hindustan Times, the recent attack on actor Tiger Shroff was mentioned.
When Ananya was asked about the heightened security concern for actors in the wake of the attack and if it has impacted her, she said, “It is very scary and extremely unfortunate. I think it will make people a little less relaxed about safety measures for everyone involved because it is not just about the actor's safety but when there is a huge crowd it is about the crowd as well."
She added, "In general, it will be for creating a safer environment because for me it will be so sad if I do not get to interact with the people who watched our films. That is the most rewarding thing as an actor, when someone comes up and tells you that they saw something in themselves with the character that you played. So, I am hopeful and I do not want that connection between actors and audience to go away. But I think safety for everyone is important, and not just actors.”
A firing incident involving Tiger Shroff has raised serious concerns in the film industry and beyond. The incident took place around 7 pm on October 18 in Mumbai, as the Bollywood actor was leaving a football club. A video of the shooting showed the attackers opening fire at his car from close range. Tiger escaped without injuries, but his driver and a bystander were reportedly hurt in the incident.
The shooting has since drawn attention to concerns over the actor’s safety, with the incident prompting questions about the circumstances surrounding the attack and the people responsible. Tiger's team has issued a strong warning against the spread of fake news and AI-generated content falsely linked to the actor. In a statement, the team clarified that Tiger has not made any public comments or released videos about a recent incident, and warned that those responsible for spreading misleading content could face legal action.
Meanwhile, a special court under the Maharashtra Control of Organised Crime Act (MCOCA) has extended the police custody of Phool Singh and four other accused in the firing case involving actor Tiger Shroff till November 16.
Santanu Das is a Senior Content Producer at Hindustan Times with over 5 years of experience, writing on films, pop culture and film festivals.
